headline: Recommended up to $200,000 for Boys & Girls Club playground and $750,000 for Families in Transition housing; approved Horseshoe Pond Place loan extension.
summary: Four CDBG applications were discussed for the January 2026 round. Two were recommended to City Council, and the other two were asked to apply in the July 2027 round. The committee also approved extending a CDBG loan for Horseshoe Pond Place.
decisions: Approved the September 19, 2025 minutes by unanimous voice vote.
Consensus to proceed with two CDBG projects now and ask the other two to apply in the July 2027 round.
Recommended to City Council up to $200,000 in CDBG funding for the Boys & Girls Club of Central & Northern NH; passed by unanimous voice vote.
Recommended to City Council up to $750,000 in CDBG funding for Families in Transition housing; passed by unanimous voice vote.
Approved the request to extend the CDBG loan term for Horseshoe Pond Place by 20 years, from July 28, 2032 to July 28, 2052; passed unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Ms. Sprague moved the approval of the September 19, 2025 minutes. Councilor Kurtz seconded the motion. The motion passed by a unanimous voice vote.

After discussing the merits of the four applications, the Committee consensus was to proceed with the 2 projects likely to score higher now, and ask that the other 2 projects submit for funding in the July 2027 application round.

Mr. Gfroerer moved that CDAC support and recommend the Public Facilities application from the Boys & Girls Club of Central & Northern NH to City Council for CDBG funding of up to $200,000. Ms. Sprague seconded the motion. The motion passed by a unanimous voice vote.

Councilor Kurtz moved that CDAC support and recommend the Housing application from Families in Transition to City Council for CDBG funding of up to $750,000. Ms. Sprague seconded the motion. The motion passed by a unanimous voice vote.

After a brief discussion of the structure of the CDBG funds as a loan versus the typical grant, the Committee unanimously approved the applicant’s request, on a motion made by Councilor Kurtz and seconded by Mr. Craig.

decision_titles: Two January 2026 CDBG applications moved to July 2027 round
Boys & Girls Club of Central & Northern NH CDBG application, up to $200,000
Families in Transition CDBG housing application, up to $750,000
Horseshoe Pond Place CDBG loan term extension
